scripts.dev: bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'node scripts/dev-health.mjs && next dev --webpack'
scripts.dev:auth: BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true bun run dev
scripts.dev:turbo: bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'node scripts/dev-health.mjs && next dev --turbo'
scripts.dev:webpack: bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'node scripts/dev-health.mjs && next dev --webpack'
scripts.bench:sala-grande: PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_SERVER=true bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'playwright test e2e/vdr-large-room-local.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 "$@"' _
scripts.build: bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'node scripts/build-viewer-assets.mjs && node scripts/quarantine-next-ds-store.mjs && next build --webpack'
scripts.build:analyze: ANALYZE=true bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'node scripts/build-viewer-assets.mjs && next build --webpack'
scripts.typecheck: bun x next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental false
scripts.typecheck:all: bun x next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental false && tsc --noEmit --project convex/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true E2E_INTAKE_FIXTURE=true E2E_SERVER_MODE=dev bash scripts/with-project-node.sh sh -c 'tsx scripts/e2e-browser-preflight.ts && playwright test e2e/landing.spec.ts e2e/critical-path.spec.ts e2e/intake-temporary-journey.spec.ts e2e/intake-deliverables-journey.spec.ts e2e/sell-side-dev-auth-journeys.spec.ts e2e/vdr-shell.spec.ts e2e/admin-preparation-oversight.spec.ts e2e/vdr-viewers.spec.ts e2e/xlsx-viewer-phases.spec.ts e2e/vdr-guest.spec.ts e2e/vdr-large-room-performance.spec.ts e2e/metadata.spec.ts e2e/admin-dashboard-responsive.spec.ts e2e/admin-routes.spec.ts e2e/navbar-responsive.spec.ts e2e/performance.spec.ts e2e/reliability/smoke.spec.ts --project=chromium' && bun run test:e2e:bundle
scripts.test:e2e:bundle: E2E_PORT=3166 E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3166 E2E_READY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3166/es BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BYPASS_AUTH=true NEXT_PUBLIC_DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true E2E_INTAKE_FIXTURE=true E2E_DEV_AUTH_USE_SEEDED_CONVEX=false NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL=https://placeholder.convex.cloud E2E_SERVER_MODE=start PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_SERVER=false bash scripts/with-project-node.sh playwright test e2e/performance-bundle.spec.ts --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0
